[[File:M20 long manga logo.png|thumb|Logo of the manga]] '''Pokémon the Movie: I Choose You!''' (Japanese: '''劇場版ポケットモンスター キミにきめた！''' ''Pocket Monsters the Movie: I Choose You!'') is a {{pkmn|manga}} adaptation of the [[M20|movie of the same name]]. It is adapted by [[Ryo Takamisaki]]. It started serializing on July 2, 2017 in MangaONE, a Japanese manga smartphone app by Shogakukan.
